legacy_reporting_protocol: Applicable only to cycles with a non-null verified historical last number and an audited canonical issue source.
Do not reserve a historical report number unless a new substantive result with independent evidence is ready to publish.
First fetch canonical issue comments and this registry; if the maximum valid issue report number exceeds the stored verified counter or conflicts exist, halt numbering and reconcile, not guess.
Check the run_id is not already reserved. If reserved, resume exactly that number; never reserve twice for the same run_id.

Atomically increment legacy_report_last_verified and append {cycle_id,run_id,number,state:'reserved'} via GitHub update_file with observed blob SHA; on stale version re-fetch/recheck/retry at most three times.

Only after successfully reading back the reservation, publish the numbered report to the canonical issue, including run_id; if issue write fails leave reservation pending and repair it later. Never reuse reserved number.
Upon success, update reservation to state:'published' with the comment link using another SHA-checked update. A published report is not independently accepted revenue or product.
